observation_rule: Only yesterday's completed UTC candle; no operator date override and no historical backfill. A missing day stays missing. Actual observation time is retained, not assumed to be the next open.

candidates.selection_note: Selected by the predeclared training screen before this campaign's evaluation. The broader dataset had already been inspected in prior studies.
Identified after comparing all 16 candidates on reused historical data; not a blind holdout winner.

entry_sizing: min(0.5,0.15/vol60), where vol60 is sample standard deviation of 60 completed daily simple returns times sqrt(365.25). Zero volatility uses 50%. Entry-only sizing, no promised volatility cap.
meaning: Signal conditions and hypothetical entry fraction only. No portfolio, fills, broker orders, paper P&L, scheduler or live-profit claim.
data_authentication: Caller-supplied OHLCV CSV. Structural integrity and stored bytes are checked; exchange origin is not authenticated by this journal.
integrity_limit: Local hashes and replay detect inconsistency, not coordinated rewriting by a privileged attacker. No external timestamp or signature.
